question: Dantidurga was associated with which of the following ruling dynasties of the early medieval India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rashtrakuta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dantidurga** was a ruler of the **Rashtrakuta Empire**, which existed in India from the **6th to the 10th century CE.**
 
• He was the **founder of the Rashtrakuta dynasty**, which played an important role in Indian history, especially in the Deccan region.
 
• Dantidurga came to power in 735 CE after overthrowing his uncle, **Kirtivarman II,** who was ruling the Rashtrakuta kingdom at that time.
 
• Dantidurga then established his capital in** Manyakheta**, which is now known as **Malkhed **in the state of Karnataka, India.
 
• During his reign, **Dantidurga consolidated the Rashtrakuta Empire** and expanded it through military conquests.
 
• 
 
He defeated the **Chalukya and the Pallava kingdoms** and also conquered parts of the southern peninsula of India.

 

Hence, we can conclude that Dantidurga was associated with Rashtrakuta__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Hoysala**__

 __
 
• **Hoysala** is a South Indian dynasty that ruled over parts of the modern-day Indian states of **Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Andhra Pradesh** from the 10th to the 14th century CE.
 
 
 
• Pala__
 __
 
• The **Pala dynasty** was a powerful imperial dynasty that ruled over the eastern part of the Indian subcontinent, in the regions of Bengal and Bihar, from the 8th to the 12th century CE.
 
• The Pala dynasty was founded by **Gopala** in the 8th century CE. 
 
 
 
• **Chola**__
 
 
• The **Chola dynasty** was a Tamil dynasty that ruled over parts of southern India from the **9th to the 13th century CE.**
 
• Under the reign of** Rajaraja Chola I (985-1014 CE) **and his son** Rajendra Chola I (1012-1044 CE),** the Cholas expanded their empire through successful military campaigns.
